title: Oral: why least squares works
summary: Two spoken questions on the normal equations and what a fit's residuals mean.
prompt: Two questions, answered aloud with no notes. Say what you would write on the board, and why each step holds.

questions.prompt: Explain why the least-squares coefficients satisfy $A^\top A\,\beta = A^\top y$. Where does the equation come from, and what does it say geometrically?
When is the least-squares solution unique, and what goes wrong when it is not?
